context: A mid-year review of the events
purpose: Review progress; teach ３月/５月/１つ/７月/日間/９月/２つ/１月

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ３月と５月のイベント、どうだった？
lines.en: How were the March and May events?
lines.style: manager opening the review, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: どちらも好評でした。特に１つ目の企画が。
lines.en: Both went over well, especially the first plan.
lines.style: pleased planner reporting success, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ７月の夏祭りは、何日間にする？

lines.style: manager looking ahead, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 三日間に拡大しようと思います。
lines.en: I’m thinking of expanding it to three days.
lines.style: ambitious planner proposing growth, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ９月の２つの催しも、準備は順調？

lines.style: manager checking readiness, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 順調です。来年の１月分も、もう構想しています。
lines.en: On track. I’m already envisioning next January.
lines.style: forward-looking planner staying ahead, tone holding steady through the whole line
